title: Chill Guy
blurb: My new character is a chill guy: a dog in a grey jumper who has problems and simply declines to engage with any of them. Philip Banks drew him in 2024, the internet immediately adopted him as a mascot for radical non-participation, and the character escaped his creator entirely within about a month. The appeal is obvious in a year that gave everyone plenty to be unchill about. Play it at the moment you decide, correctly, that something is not worth a single further unit of your energy.
origin: From the viral 'Chill Guy' character meme.
